name: scryv2
description: The revised scry.io proposal (fetched 2026-08-17, data/manifund/scry_v2_2026-08-17.json) against its original and against the slate. Phase 1 judges the actual rewrite: full text (title-blurb-description, one line, 8k cap) old vs new, every fable attribute, independent draws. Phase 2 isolates the blurb change in the slate's own one-line register. Phase 3 places the revised line in the 40-proposal pool (appended as line 41 so the original 40 keep their entity ids and texts byte-identical - pool-pool pairs replay from the content-addressed cache; only pairs touching the new entity buy GPU).
